preconditions.description: The size of the grid n must be between 2 and 100.
Alice's chosen color a must be one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3.
Bob's chosen color b must be one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3 and must not be equal to Alice's color a.

postconditions.description: Bob must output the chosen color b and the coordinates i, j of the cell where the token is placed.

postconditions.expression: not any(grid[i][j] == grid[i+1][j] or grid[i][j] == grid[i][j+1] for i in range(n-1) for j in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: There must be no adjacent cells with tokens of the same color after Bob's move.

postconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] is not None for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: All cells in the grid must be filled after n^2 turns.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] in {1, 2, 3} for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
invariants.description: All tokens in the grid must be of one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] != grid[i+1][j] for i in range(n-1) for j in range(n))
invariants.description: No two adjacent cells in the same column can have tokens of the same color.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] != grid[i][j+1] for i in range(n) for j in range(n-1))
invariants.description: No two adjacent cells in the same row can have tokens of the same color.
